subject: english
title: Extra Reading 7–9 App — Leonardo da Vinci
subtitle: Checkpoint after Units 7–9 · 8 modules: Academic Language, Reading Words, Read Together, Text Features, The Timeline, Complete & Discuss, Express Yourself, Can Leo Score?

content: Identify the four kinds of text feature and find them on Student Book pages 164–165.
Identify the elements of a biography and give five facts about Leonardo's life.
Read a timeline in chronological order and use it to answer questions.
Choose one way to express yourself about Leonardo, prepare it, and share it with real feedback.
language: Use the academic words design, label, range, and structure.
Use the reading words fascinated, glider, kindness, release, and vegetarian.
Give an opinion with a reason using because.
Give feedback with the four Share frames from the Student Book.
